# Candidate Show HN post

Title: Show HN: Drop in a folder of HTML and get back a private URL
Project URL: https://eze.page/
Posted (UTC): 2026-10-20T23:45:03Z

## Project page text (fetch status: ok)

```text
Turn a folder into a private website for your team.
eze is open-source hosting you run inside your company. Upload some HTML and get a link that only your coworkers can open. Every site gets a database, live updates, file uploads and AI, with nothing to set up.
Set it up
GitHub
Self-hosted. MIT license.
lunch-vote
index.html
poll.js
style.css
eze deploy
lunch-vote.eze.acme.com
Where should we eat on Friday?
Ramen place on 5th
9
Tacos
4
Salad bar
1
AN
BO
CY
DE
4 people from Acme are voting
How it works
Make a site
Write plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript yourself, or ask your AI tool to.
Deploy it
Run
eze deploy
or drop the folder on the eze dashboard.
Share the link
Anyone signed in to your company can open it. Nobody else can.
A backend without a backend
Pages load one script from eze and can save data, react to changes and know who is looking. They use the viewer's company sign-in, so there are no keys in your code.
<script src="/_q/sdk.js"></script>
<script type="module">
const me = await eze.id.me();
const votes = eze.db.collection('votes');
await votes.create({ place: 'Ramen', by: me.name });
votes.subscribe({ onCreate: (vote) => redraw() });
</script>
eze.db
Save and query data, with live updates
eze.files
Uploads like images, video and PDFs
eze.ws
Rooms for cursors, chat and games
eze.ai
Call Claude, OpenAI or your own model
eze.id
The name and email of whoever is viewing
Works with your AI tools
eze init
adds instructions that teach coding agents how to build an eze site.
eze mcp
lets Claude Code, Cursor and other MCP apps deploy sites for you.
claude mcp add eze -- eze mcp
> make a site where my team can vote
on where to eat on Friday
Set it up
You need a server, a domain with wildcard DNS and HTTPS, and your company's sign-in: Google Workspace, Okta, Entra ID or any OpenID Connect provider, or an auth proxy you already use.
eze is one program with a small database file. A small VM is plenty.
Read the setup guide
go install github.com/ahyield/eze/cmd/eze@latest
EZE_DOMAIN=eze.acme.com \
EZE_AUTH=oidc \
EZE_OIDC_ISSUER=https://accounts.google.com \
EZE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID=... \
EZE_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET=... \
EZE_OIDC_ALLOWED_DOMAINS=acme.com \
EZE_SESSION_SECRET=... \
eze serve
Only for your company
Everyone who can sign in can open, change and redeploy every site. That keeps eze simple, so keep it to your own people: eze won't start if its sign-in would let in a public email domain like gmail.com.
Found a security problem?
Report it privately
.
```

{"decision": "push", "reason": "页面清楚展示了一个具体小产品：把一个 HTML 文件夹变成只有公司内部人员能打开的私有链接，并附带数据库、实时更新和公司登录的无配置后端，还有投票午餐的实例。这是对内部小工具分享这一常见问题的有新意的切入角度，页面也专业完整。"}

verdict.reasoning: The reason's claims all match the page: a folder of HTML becomes a private link only coworkers can open, with a database, live updates and company sign-in, and the lunch-vote example. These are concrete details from this post, and the positive framing ("novel angle", "professional and complete" page) supports push.
